name: Pagination
purpose: Breaks longer lists of content into digestible chunks and helps with content load times by letting users move between pages of results. Browser-only.
$family: Covers the 'Pagination (browser)' canvas: Pagination basic, Pagination dropdown, Pagination dropdown stacked, plus atoms — page-size dropdown (.Dropdown), Go button, Arrow button.

props.name: state
props.$note: Page buttons / dropdown trigger states; current page marked active.

variants.name: basic
variants.use: Numbered page buttons with prev/next arrows; current page outlined (tertiary/border/default). CLEAN.

variants.name: dropdown
variants.use: Page selector as a dropdown (jump to page) on one row.

variants.name: dropdown-stacked
variants.use: Stacked layout of the dropdown variant for narrower widths.

page-size-dropdown.use: Single-select dropdown trigger (closed/bottom/top × default/hover/completed) — reuses the Dropdown form-trigger pattern.

go-button.use: Secondary-style 'Go' button to jump to a typed page.

tokens.dropdown-trigger (DEPRECATED set): interactive (depricate)/on-light/surface/primary/default|hover + border/active/default + border/high-contrast/default + non-interactive surface/neutral-6/2 — see tokenValidation (form-trigger pattern)

accessibility.nav: Wrap in a <nav aria-label='Pagination'>; mark the current page with aria-current='page'
accessibility.controls: Prev/next arrows and Go need accessible names; disabled prev/next at list ends must be programmatically disabled
accessibility.dropdown: Page-size/page dropdown needs a label and standard listbox semantics
accessibility.useOfColour: Current page must not be indicated by the outline colour alone — pair with aria-current

antiPatterns: Marking the current page by border colour only (add aria-current)
Leaving prev/next enabled past the first/last page
Leaving the dropdown trigger + Go/Arrow borders on the deprecated tokens — migrate to form/* + secondary/border/default (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — Pagination basic CLEAN; dropdown variant + page-size dropdown + Go/Arrow buttons carry deprecated tokens, all with known clean rebinds.

tokens.usedBy: Pagination dropdown + page-size dropdown active border

depricateUsage.note: The page-size dropdown reuses the Dropdown component's form-trigger pattern (same depricate set, same form/* rebinds). The brand-2 border (#000) on Go/Arrow is the secondary-button border. Pagination basic is fully migrated. See $interactive_namespace_note for the namespace question.
